exposure: women screened with the IADSPG criteria
women screened with the two-step criteria
International Association of Diabetes in Pregnancy Study Group (IADSPG) criteria
two- step criteria for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) screening
outcome: 5' Apgar score less than to 7 at birth
cohort: 6051 patients who delivered between January 2009 and December 2014
finding: The introduction of IADPSG screening criteria significantly increased the prevalence of GDM but did not have a statistically significant impact on pregnancy outcomes.
